#!/bin/busybox sh

INITRC_DIR=/sbin/initrc
DEFAULT_MODE=0
KMSG=/dev/kmsg
BOOT_TIME=/proc/snsc_boot_time
MODE_FILE=/setting/mode/dmode
SEN_FILE=/setting/sen/smode
NO_LDR_FILE=/sbin/NOLDR
NO_LDR_MODE=0

export HOME=/
export PATH=/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:$PATH
export TOPRC=/etc/toprc
export MALLOC_OPTIONS=gfffffffff
export MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_=131072
export MALLOC_CHECK_=3
export LT_ABORTREASON=0
export WBSHD=/tmp_wbshd/shared.XXXXXX

busybox mount -o rw -t proc proc /proc
mkdir -p /dev/pts

[ -r $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv1  ] && . $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv1
[ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_nflash ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_nflash
[ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_rootfs ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_rootfs

/sbin/init2

while true
do
    ash --login
done

#!/bin/busybox sh

INITRC_DIR=/sbin/initrc
DEFAULT_MODE=3
KMSG=/dev/kmsg
BOOT_TIME=/proc/snsc_boot_time
MODE_FILE=/setting/mode/dmode
SEN_FILE=/setting/sen/smode
FSTAB=$INITRC_DIR/fstab
FSTAB_EXT=$INITRC_DIR/fstab.ext

setup_bis()
{
    UPM_BOOTMODE=`cat /proc/udm/upm_bootmode`
    echo "upm_bootmode = $UPM_BOOTMODE" > $KMSG
    echo "upm_bootmode = $UPM_BOOTMODE" > $BOOT_TIME

    [ "$UPM_BOOTMODE" != "BIS" ] && return 1

    SSBIPROF_MNTSRC=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 1`
    SSBIPROF_MNTTGT=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 2`
    SSBIPROF_MNTOPT=`grep -v '^#' $FSTAB | grep /log | busybox cut -f 4`

    busybox umount $SSBIPROF_MNTTGT
    /sbin/mkdosfs -f 1 -s 32 $SSBIPROF_MNTSRC
    busybox mount $SSBIPROF_MNTSRC $SSBIPROF_MNTTGT -o $SSBIPROF_MNTOPT

    return 0
}

setup_senser()
{
    [ -r $SEN_FILE ] || return 1

#   echo $SEN_FILE found.
    SEN_STR=`cat $SEN_FILE`
    if   [ "$SEN_STR" == "UU" ] ; then
        /usr/bin/sen.elf &
    fi

    return 0
}

busybox mount -t sysfs none /sys
busybox mount -t debugfs none /sys/kernel/debug
busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB

[ -r $FSTAB_EXT ] && busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB_EXT

mount -t tmpfs none /tmp_wbshd

MODE="$DEFAULT_MODE"
[ -r $MODE_FILE ] && MODE=`cat $MODE_FILE`

if [ "$MODE" != "0" ] ; then
    ### set_mindrv()
    echo set > /proc/udm/drivers

    [ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_shielding ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_shielding
    [ -r $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv2     ] && . $INITRC_DIR/insmod_drv2

    setup_bis || setup_senser

    /usr/bin/bootin.elf &
fi

[ -r $INITRC_DIR/setup_console ] && . $INITRC_DIR/setup_console

while true
do
    ash --login
done

ROOTFS_OLDTGT="/initrd"
FSTAB_ROOT="$INITRC_DIR/fstab.root"

do_pivot_root()
{
	[ -r $FSTAB_ROOT ] || return 1
	busybox mount -a -T $FSTAB_ROOT

	ROOTFS_MNTTGT=`busybox cut -f 2 $FSTAB_ROOT`

	cd $ROOTFS_MNTTGT

	/sbin/pivot_root . $ROOTFS_MNTTGT$ROOTFS_OLDTGT

	busybox mount --move $ROOTFS_OLDTGT/proc /proc
	busybox mount --move $ROOTFS_OLDTGT/dev  /dev

	exec busybox chroot . /bin/ash -c "busybox umount $ROOTFS_OLDTGT; freeramdisk /dev/ram0; /sbin/init2;" < dev/console > dev/console 2>&1
}

busybox mount | grep nfs >> /dev/null
is_nfs=$?
if [ "$is_nfs" != 0 ] ; then
	do_pivot_root
fi

conclusions: Selected fstab binds /tmp to nflasha10, not tmpfs. /tmp_wbshd is separately mounted tmpfs.
Selected init2 optionally starts /usr/bin/sen.elf when /setting/sen/smode contains UU. This is distinct from the auth AA mode-file tail.
No /ramdsk mount or symlink resolved in these six scripts or root image entry inventory; this bounded search does not establish its runtime backing.
